exact_missing_items: Add a canonical append-only event/record family for account-pressure and switching: account_pressure_episode and account_switch_event

account_pressure_episode fields: episode_id, project_id, provider_id, account_id, execution_role?, source_kind, signal_confidence, pressure_kind, projected_remaining?, reset_at?, started_at_utc, updated_at_utc, ended_at_utc?, status

account_switch_event fields: switch_event_id, project_id, provider_id, execution_role?, requested_account_id?, from_account_id?, to_account_id?, switch_reason, decision_kind, source_episode_id?, run_id?, attempt_id?, thread_id?, ts
Add project_attention_item projection family to storage-plan.md with canonical shape and projection freshness / trust-state contract
Add rollup rules (severity-merge, collapse criteria, forced-split criteria) to the attention item family definition
Add disclosure-visibility rules: inline surface, click-to-expand, navigate-to-attention-center
Bind attention center widget in FinalGUISpec.md to the projection family, not to live polling
Projection-freshness trust vocabulary must be distinct from Preview trust_tier — trust_tier is already occupied in that namespace
Projection trust vocabulary must use a different name such as projection_freshness, data_freshness, or staleness_state
Using trust_tier for both preview capability trust and projection freshness would create a naming collision across surfaces
The canonical minimum field set is: `target_kind`; `project_id`; one canonical target selector (`subject_id` OR `object_kind` + `object_id`)
The narrow scope-restoration fields are: `focused_run_id`; `thread_id`
The narrow focus-refinement fields are: `tab_id`; `inspector_target`
Full bounded shape: `target_kind`, `project_id`, `focused_run_id`, `thread_id`, `tab_id`, `subject_id`, `object_kind`, `object_id`, `inspector_target`
`project_id` is required. Exactly one canonical target selector is required.

What is NOT a base `route_target` field: `usage_event_ref`, `wizard_id`, `wizard_step`, `message_id`, `artifact_id`, `document_id`, `workflow_run_id`, `scheduler_pass_id`, `safe_point_id`, `remediation_root_id`, `line`, `range`, per-surface state (`active_subview`, compare target, panel layout, browser tab state, widget layout)
The canonical selector rule is: exactly one primary selector is present: `subject_id` OR `object_kind` + `object_id`
`subject_id` wins for openable/renderable content subjects.
`object_kind` + `object_id` wins for domain/runtime/governance objects.
`tab_id`, `focused_run_id`, `thread_id`, and `inspector_target` never replace primary selector identity.
`project_id` is required scope, not selector identity.

Resolution order: (1) restore project_id, (2) restore route scope (focused_run_id, thread_id), (3) restore destination class from target_kind, (4) resolve primary selector (subject_id OR object_kind+object_id), (5) apply narrow focus refinement (tab_id, inspector_target)
Reject multi-selector route payloads as non-canonical. Normalize all special-case ids into `subject_id` or `object_kind` + `object_id` before they enter the canonical route layer.
Use `subject_id` only when the target is canonical renderable/openable content.
Use `object_kind` + `object_id` for all runtime, governance, conversational, and workflow objects.
The canonical `subject_id` families remain: `doc:<document_id>`; `artifact:<artifact_id>`
Everything else routes through `object_kind` + `object_id`.
Put the classification rule directly in `Contracts_V0.md`.
Keep `subject_id` frozen to the two canonical families until a new cross-surface content identity proves necessary.
`subject_id` is not a second generic object taxonomy. If `subject_id` expands carelessly, the whole routing model becomes muddy again.
Use projection_freshness as the canonical recency field and projection_health as the canonical reliability/usability field
Reserve trust_tier for preview/browser semantics only unless those docs are later explicitly renamed too
Make Glossary.md own the canonical term meanings for projection freshness and projection health
Let surface docs consume those terms instead of inventing local stale/degraded wording
Keep action gating rules tied to both axes: stale-but-healthy may allow read-only use with warning; degraded or unavailable should gate mutating actions much more aggressively
`resume_url` is a serialized transport of `route_target`.
`resume_url` must stay narrower than the internal route contract.
The serialized form carries: stable primary selector identity; required scope when needed; narrow anchor detail when the flow requires it
The serialized form does not carry: shell layout state; panel widths; widget state; broad filter state; provider/account disclosure data
`resume_url` decodes into `route_target`. `resume_url` does not define a second routing ontology.

Good serialized fields: `project_id`; `subject_id` or `object_kind` + `object_id`; `thread_id` when thread scope is required; `focused_run_id` when run scope is required; narrow anchor detail such as wizard-step focus when the workflow requires exact resumption
Define `resume_url` as serialized `route_target` transport in `Contracts_V0.md`. State the allowed serialized data classes directly.
do not over-promise undo when the system really only supports compensating actions
Undo only when true immediate undo exists; Reopen, Restore, Retry from Safe Point, Create New Lane, Re-request Promotion, Reapply for distinct compensating cases
strong confirmations should show: action name, target object(s), concrete consequence summary, whether local work/artifacts/history remain, reversibility class
hard_gate should show: runtime-defined allowed actions, why the gate exists, exact consequence of each allowed action, no hidden alternative path
stale_tokens: resume_url stronger than general route contract
canonical_replacement_hints: object_kind + object_id for wizard_id, message_id, usage_event, scheduler_pass_id, safe_point_id, remediation_root_id
object_kind + object_id for all listed special-case IDs
Undo / Reopen / Restore / Retry from Safe Point / Create New Lane / Re-request Promotion / Reapply
